scientific_integrity: The claimed all-integer formulas are analytically proved; numerical tests are corroborative only. Prior k=2 edge-midpoint result is excluded from the new theorem and explicitly acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Real scalar linear extensions, side-one regular Euclidean simplexes, all barycenters from one fixed face cardinality k>=3. Mixed ranks, nonregular simplexes and general Banach-valued extensions are not covered. Bibliographic completeness and independent validation remain open.
title: Sharp simultaneous Lipschitz interpolation on all regular-simplex faces and a seventeen-vertex extremum
